description: Validates an EU VAT number against the European Commission's VIES system, the check required for zero-rated intra-community invoices: valid or not, and the registered name and address when the member state publishes them. All 27 member states plus Northern Ireland (XI); Greece accepted as GR or EL. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
